item_01.why_target: A disjoint union is coloured by colouring each system independently, so the discrepancy of the union is just the larger of the two discrepancies.
item_01.why_bound: sqrt(n log(m/n)) with n additive squares to n1 log + n2 log, i.e. B(I1+I2)^2 = B(I1)^2 + B(I2)^2.

item_02.why_target: Amplification that grows the instance by only a bounded factor per step keeps size linear.
item_02.why_bound: k-fold parallel repetition raises the instance size to the k-th power.

item_03.why_target: CFGS give Delta = ceil(n^{1/2}) and n is additive, so Delta^2 adds.
item_03.why_bound: A (1/2)log_2 n bound under additive n gives log(n1+n2), which is none of the shapes.

item_04.why_target: The product of caps is a cap of size |A1||A2|, so cap size multiplies as c^n.
item_04.why_bound: 3^n/n^{1+eps} is not of the form c^n.

item_05.why_target: (1-eps^2)^{O(k)} splits as a product across coordinates.

item_06.why_target: val(G^2) > val(G)^2 because provers correlate, so no law of these shapes.
item_06.why_bound: The conjectured invariant is by definition a product across coordinates.

item_07.why_target: Larsen-Nelson is Theta(log n / eps^2) and log n is additive.
item_07.why_bound: O(log n / eps^2) is linear in the additive parameter log n.

item_08.why_target: Capacity is the limit of alpha(G^{box k})^{1/k}; alpha(C5 box C5)=5 > 4.

item_09.why_target: The largest root of a direct sum is the largest root among the blocks.
item_09.why_bound: delta <~ 1/log n degrades logarithmically, which is none of the shapes.

item_10.why_target: omega is defined by a limit over tensor powers.
item_10.why_bound: Border rank is submultiplicative under tensor product.

item_11.why_target: CFGS give Delta = ceil(n^{1/2}) and n adds.

item_12.why_target: A product of downward-closed extremal systems has |F1||F2| sets.
item_12.why_bound: For fixed ground set Sauer-Shelah behaves like n^d.

item_13.why_target: Independent sets in strong powers multiply.

item_14.why_target: Pach-Tardos hard instances force the requirement from a single component.
item_14.why_bound: Net size is linear in d and d is additive.
